video_title: Boogie - Heat Will Be BEST Defensive Team in NBA! Giannis Makes Heat CONTENDERS?!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons questions the spacing fit of Giannis and Bam
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that style is going to work the best way.
quotes.quote: First of all, I think Giannis, if he's healthy, is a top-three player in the NBA. I think he's unbelievable. I just think basketball-wise, the simple spacing with him and Bam, I don't think that's the best fit. I don't think that style is going to work the best way. I think their bench is really weak and thin. Adding Tim Hardaway Jr. helps, he can shoot the ball and they're going to need as much shooting as possible. Klay Thompson is obviously one of the best shooters of all time, but what version of him are we going to get this year? When you look at their team, I think their starting five is solid, but how deep can they go? I think Giannis is a 30 and 14 guy and Bam is going to put up his numbers, but outside of that, I don't think they're one of the elite teams in the Eastern Conference, mainly because of the way they play and the spacing with Giannis. It's going to be interesting to see what Coach Spoelstra does with that offense.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams defends the toughness and role players of Miami
quotes.excerpt: I just can't turn my back on a Giannis-Bam duo.
quotes.quote: I just can't turn my back on a Giannis-Bam duo. And then you got Klay Thompson, you got Andrew Wiggins, you got Bobby Portis. You have great role players that know their position. And I think one of the underrated things that they have on their side is toughness. This is a tough crew. Whether we like their style of play or not, whether we think that they fit this style of play in the game right now with so many threes and playing at a fast pace, I think that benefits them.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins emphasizes the championship DNA of the Heat
quotes.excerpt: This is the Miami Heat. They hang their hat on defense, they hang their hat on toughness.
quotes.quote: I agree with both of you guys when it comes to the offensive side of the ball, but this is the Miami Heat. They hang their hat on defense, they hang their hat on toughness, conditioning. That starting five shows all of that. Not only that part, but you got three champions in the starting lineup. That DNA, that experience, you can't ignore that.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins predicts the Heat will be the best defensive team
quotes.excerpt: I think they're probably going to be the best defensive team in the league this year.
quotes.quote: I think they're probably going to be the best defensive team in the league this year. You got two versatile bigs that can guard five positions on the floor. You got a pitbull at the point guard position in Davion Mitchell. You have two great wings that have done this at a high level. They're very versatile as well. So I like this group defensively. I do think it's a lot to figure out on the offensive side of the ball, and I've spoken on this before, and I'm going to keep that same energy. It's something to figure out between Bam and Giannis, and the spacing will become an issue unless Bam just becomes this elite wing and corner shooter, which I have yet to see yet.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons questions who will create offense for the Heat
quotes.excerpt: I just don't know in the half-court offense, 10 seconds left in the game, where do they go?
quotes.quote: I'm just thinking I guess game on the line in the half-court, like where do they go? I think they're going to be awesome in transition, I think they're going to be great defensively. I just don't know where they're going to create their offense from if it's not Giannis out in transition and Bam in the post. I just don't know in the half-court offense, 10 seconds left in the game, where do they go? As the head point, the starting point guard, I just don't know in the half-court offense, 10 seconds left in the game, where do they go? I think they're going to be awesome in transition, I think they're going to be great defensively. I just don't know where they're going to create their offense from if it's not Giannis out in transition and Bam in the post.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams discusses Giannis Antetokounmpo's need to develop a mid-range game
quotes.excerpt: He's talked about openly about embracing the mid-range, embracing shooting those open shots.
quotes.quote: Let's see if we get a new version of Giannis. He's talked about openly about embracing the mid-range, embracing shooting those open shots from 15 feet on out. Let's see if it translates. All of our legends at some point, they get to a point in their career where they have to put something new in their game. That was the only thing left for Giannis to put in his bag, is to be a threat 15 feet away from the rim with his jump shot. If that's something that he can add to the table, maybe that changes the entirety of how we look at the Miami Heat.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons argues the Pistons are being underrated
quotes.excerpt: I think we're sleeping on the Pistons a little bit. They're a great regular season team.
quotes.quote: The Pistons did win 60 plus games last year. I think we're sleeping on the Pistons a little bit. They're a great regular season team. Yes, they didn't play great in the playoffs, but man, that team, basically all coming back with John Collins, with Isaiah Joe, like they're the only team that had confusion in the off-season though. That's the one thing. They're the only team that had confusion out of everybody in the East. It was clear, teams got better, they sorted out all their confusion.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams predicts Trae Young will be an All-Star
quotes.excerpt: I think Trae Young is an All-Star this year.
quotes.quote: I think Trae Young is an All-Star this year. I like how he played in the preseason. He wasn't shooting everything, he was trying to get guys involved. I thought I saw his father on Twitter saying that he agreed with a comment somebody said he was entering his Isaiah Thomas-like phase where he's going to be a distributing type of player. He got weapons around him and AJ is must-see TV, a healthy AJ, and that three and with the other young guys that they got, they might make some noise. Don't be surprised.
